model: SKG4 gas-fired steam humidifier (Modbus communication module)
applies_to: Neptronic SKG4 series gas-fired steam humidifiers (one to four burner modules) with the Modbus communication module, guide SKG4-Modbus Guide-221114 (V2.04).
summary: The Neptronic SKG4 is a gas-fired steam humidifier built from up to four burner modules. Its Modbus RTU module exposes holding registers only: signal voltages, room and supply RH, per-module chimney, water and ambient temperatures, fan feedback, demand and maximum output, PID and boiler settings, per-module inputs and valve states as 0/1 registers, and module state, request and alarm codes.

addressing.note: The guide prints a protocol-base (0-based) address and a six-digit holding register (base 400001) side by side, e.g. 6005 / 406006. The protocol-base number is the wire address.

source.title: SKG4 Gas Fired Humidifier - Modbus Communication Module User Guide

notes: Only function codes 03, 06 and 16 are supported, so binary points (inputs, relays, flags) are 16-bit holding registers holding 0 or 1.
'Scale N' with 'Value x N' means the raw value is the engineering value times N; this map stores the multiplier 1/N.
Temperature and capacity units follow Modbus Server Units (415001): 0 metric, 1 imperial.
The guide text calls automatic baud detection the default, while register 1 lists 19200 as its default value; the baud default is left blank here.
Default unit address is not stated; it is set from the device menu or register 0.

Left out: product name ASCII registers 3-6; Room RH Bias 6008 (a bias printed with a 0-100 % range and 100 % default); module water levels 6018/6023/6028/6033 (Scale 10 but 'Value x 100' example); Boiler Idle Temperature Setpoint 6155 (scale and example disagree); Humidity Demand Low Dead Band 6162-6163 and the ignition counters 6164-6179, and all run/on/service time and calibration counters, which span two or four registers with no stated word order.
Module 1-4 Drain Valve (12056-12059) are printed with 0 = On, 1 = Off, the reverse of the other valve points; copied as printed.

integration.summary: Read Room RH (6005), Humidity Demand (6054), System Power Output (6055) and each module's State and Alarm (15015-15026). For BAS control set Control Profile (15004) and Demand Source (15011) to network options and write Humidity Control Network Demand (6052) within the Network Timeout.
integration.enable: Fit the Modbus communication module, set the address in the device menu (or register 0) and pick network profile and sources (15004-15012) if the BAS supplies readings or demand.
integration.watchdog: Network Timeout (6158, 1-900 s, default 900 s): network-supplied values must be refreshed within this time; Network Control State (12051) shows a fault.
quirks: All points, binary ones included, are holding registers (FC03/06/16 only).
Default framing is no parity with 2 stop bits.
setup: RS-485 two-wire, RTU; 9600-57600 baud or auto baud detection.
Parity/stop bits via register 2 or the Modbus Comport Config menu item.
gotchas: Module 2-4 registers only respond meaningfully on units with that many burner modules.
System Mode (15034) chooses parallel, sequential or hybrid staging of modules.

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
note: Re-typed from the manufacturer's public documentation (see source) and verified against it. Registers vary by firmware and options; verify against the live device before writing.
